intro: The Pavo table is the perfect bedside companion. With its durable construction, smooth finish, and smart storage, it brings a seamless blend of practicality and modern design to compact bedrooms.

features.title: Materials that handle life’s demands
features.text: Durable enough for daily life, this sturdy design ensures your furniture stays reliable, stylish, and ready for anything.

features.title: Easy-clean surface for stress-free living
features.text: A sleek finish enhances the table’s style while making cleaning quick and hassle-free—perfect for busy homes.

features.title: Drawer glides easily with roller slides
features.text: Designed with a smooth-gliding drawer, our bedside solution keeps your nighttime essentials neatly tucked away while ensuring everything you need is right where you want it.

features.title: Space-efficient design saves room
features.text: When space is tight, every detail matters. Our design blends streamlined storage with clean, modern lines to bring function and effortless style into any room.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
